name: io.github.knorby/open-drug-data-mcp
title: Open Drug Data
description: Research drugs, supplements, and cosmetic ingredients across public databases.

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional openFDA key for a higher upstream rate limit.

environmentVariables.name: DSLD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional NIH DSLD key for a higher upstream rate limit.

environmentVariables.name: UMLS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Required only for UMLS reference searches.

environmentVariables.name: NLM_PUBMED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional NCBI E-utilities key for PubMed requests.

environmentVariables.name: NLM_PUBMED_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional contact address sent with PubMed requests.

environmentVariables.name: NLM_PUBMED_TOOL
environmentVariables.description: Optional tool name sent with PubMed requests.

environmentVariables.name: DRUGDATA_SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Shared wall-clock deadline for search fan-out and enrichment.
